instruction: I will be a resident of Futian District, Shenzhen and need to access community services. Please help me find the addresses of 3 community service centers in Futian District and save them in Chinese to this open Word document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press("enter");

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for 3 社区服务中心 locations in Futian District, Shenzhen and saving them in Chinese to the Word document. The evaluator checks if at least 3 location entries are present in the document with partial credit for fewer locations.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Full score (1.0) for 3+ locations, partial credit proportional to locations found
metadata.verification: The metric validates paragraphs as community service center addresses by checking: (1) Contains Chinese characters, (2) At least 15 characters long, (3) Mentions Futian District (福田区/福田) OR (mentions service centers (社区服务中心/服务中心) AND contains address patterns like 区/街道/路/号). Score = min(valid_count / 3, 1.0)

llm_judge_reasons: Metric correctly validates Chinese text using regex pattern [\u4e00-\u9fff] (line 45)
Metric checks for Futian District keywords (福田区/福田) as required by instruction (line 49)
Metric checks for service center keywords (社区服务中心/服务中心) matching instruction requirements (line 52)
Metric validates address-like patterns using common Chinese address components (区/街道/路/号/大厦/大楼/社区) (line 55)
Length threshold of 15 characters is appropriate for filtering meaningful Chinese addresses (line 41)
Validation logic (has_futian OR (has_service_center AND has_address_pattern)) provides flexible but effective filtering (line 60)
Partial credit scoring is proportional and reasonable (lines 69-72)
Postconfig properly saves document before evaluation using Ctrl+S (lines 45-54)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider making validation stricter by requiring both Futian keywords AND service center keywords to prevent false positives (change OR to AND at line 60)
